observed: Operations on concurim.TracedQueue, TracedLock, TracedSemaphore, TracedEvent, TracedCondition and TracedThreadPoolExecutor, when the program uses them
Explicit concurim.work() spans and lineage annotations, when used
With source included: the line each worker is on, sampled every few milliseconds (approximate)
Start, finish and failure of every threading.Thread started during the run, including subclasses that override run()
queue.Queue objects created during the run (put/get/task_done/join/shutdown)

threading Lock, RLock, Semaphore, BoundedSemaphore, Event, Condition, ThreadPoolExecutor and ProcessPoolExecutor (submit, and task start/end as reported by each worker process) created by the program's own code
asyncio tasks (creation, each step the event loop runs, end) and asyncio Queue, Lock, Semaphore, BoundedSemaphore, Event and Condition created during the run
not_observed: CPU scheduling and GIL ownership (not derivable from these events)
What a worker does between instrumented operations, except the sampled line (short-lived lines can be missed)
Anything inside child processes; multiprocessing is seen only through ProcessPoolExecutor, at the sync level and above
Queues created before recording, LifoQueue, PriorityQueue and SimpleQueue
Locks and executors created inside libraries or the standard library, and any created before recording
What an asyncio task awaits when it is not one of the above (sleep, I/O, futures), eagerly started tasks' first step, and loops other than the standard one
